**CustomAchievements 1.11.0** — for Paper 1.21.4 (Java 21). Drop the jar into
your server's `plugins/` folder. New config options are merged into your
existing `config.yml` automatically on first startup.

### Added

- **`CUSTOM` trigger — drive achievements from anything else on your server.**
  An objective can now listen for a **key you invent** rather than a Minecraft
  value. Build one with trigger `CUSTOM`, target `boss_kill`, amount `10`, then
  fire it:

  ```
  /ca trigger <player> <key> [amount]        # add (default 1)
  /ca trigger <player> <key> set <value>     # set an absolute value
  ```

  It's an ordinary console command, so anything that can run one can advance an
  achievement — nothing to compile against, no API needed:

  ```applescript
  # Skript
  execute console command "ca trigger %player% boss_kill"

  # Skript — push a total you already track yourself
  execute console command "ca trigger %player% points set %{points::%uuid of player%}%"
  ```

  Plugins that run reward commands — MythicMobs skills, quest plugins, crate
  plugins, ExecutableItems, Citizens — work the same way: hand them
  `ca trigger %player% <key>` as the command to run.

  - Keys are free text, matched **case-insensitively**: `boss_kill`,
    `quest:step3`, `Weekly Event`.
  - `trigger` **adds** to a running count; `set` writes an absolute value, so a
    script repeating `set 6` stays at 6 rather than climbing.
  - Target `ANY` matches **every** custom key.
  - The player must be online, and the caller needs
    `customachievements.admin` — which the console always has.

  Reading progress back already works from any script through PlaceholderAPI:
  `%customachievements_progress_<id>%`, `_status_<id>%`, `_percent_<id>%`.

- **A small Java API** for plugins that would rather call directly than run a
  command. Soft-depend on `CustomAchievements` and use:

  ```java
  import com.diamend.customachievements.api.CustomAchievementsAPI;

  CustomAchievementsAPI.trigger(player, "boss_kill");        // +1
  CustomAchievementsAPI.trigger(player, "boss_kill", 5);     // +5
  CustomAchievementsAPI.set(player, "points", 42);           // absolute
  CustomAchievementsAPI.hasCompleted(player, "boss_slayer");
  CustomAchievementsAPI.grant(player, "boss_slayer");
  ```

  Every call is a no-op when the plugin isn't installed, so soft-dependants
  don't have to guard each one.

- **`/ca backfill [player] [redo]` — find out why a statistic didn't show up.**
  If an achievement stayed at 0 for someone who clearly has the statistic, this
  re-runs the seeding for that player and prints what it actually read:

  ```
  kill_1000 #0 ENTITY_KILL PLAYER — statistic 1432, set to 1000/1000
  old_hunter #0 ENTITY_KILL ZOMBIE — already seeded once; add "redo" to force
  named_sword #0 ITEM_HAVE Excalibur — no statistic exists for this objective
  ```

  An objective is marked seeded even when the read comes back empty, so a first
  run that found nothing is never retried on later joins. `redo` forces a fresh
  re-seed of every unfinished objective:

  ```
  /ca backfill <player> redo
  ```

  Seeding still never lowers progress, so forcing it is safe. **If 1.10.0's
  backfill didn't credit your players' past kills, this is how to retry it.**

### Note

The statistics backfill added in 1.10.0 can't seed `CUSTOM` objectives — the
server keeps no statistic for a key you invented, so they start at zero.
